title: Number of people requiring interventions against neglected tropical diseases
graph_title: Number of people requiring interventions against neglected tropical diseases
national_indicator_available: Number of people in need of preventive chemotherapy for neglected tropical diseases
national_indicator_description: The World Health Organization (WHO) tracks the population requiring and receiving preventive chemotherapy for lymphatic filariasis, onchoceriasis, schistosomiasis, soil-transmitted helminthiases and trachoma. In Rwanda, preventive chemotherapy is required for schistosomiasis and soil-transmitted helminthiases; the figures reported here correspond to the number of people in need of preventive chemotherapy for at least one of these two diseases.
computation_definitions: Number of people requiring preventive chemotherapy (PC) for schistosomiasis or soil-transmitted helminthiases.
computation_calculations: (Population in need not covered by PC) + (Population in need covered by PC)
other_info: Additional data on preventative chemotherapy targeting and coverage for other time periods are available from other sources. Data from 2006 to 2010 are available from the article [Schistosomiasis and soil-transmitted helminthiasis in Rwanda - an update on their epidemiology and control](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s40249-016-0212-z), which uses World Health Organization (WHO) figures from that period. Data from 2025 and 2026 are available from the [Rwanda Malaria and Neglected Tropical Diseases Annual Reports](https://rbc.gov.rw/publications/reports) for the relevant years, published by the Rwanda Biomedical Centre (RBC).
comments_limitations: The global metadata for this indicator specifies that it should include both the number of people requiring preventive chemotherapy for the relevant neglected tropical diseases, and the number of new cases requiring treatment and care for other neglected tropical diseases. Due to data availability, this indicator only includes information on the number of people requiring preventive chemotherapy. However, some information on treatment of other neglected tropical diseases is available in the [Demographic and Health Survey 2025](https://statistics.gov.rw/data-sources/surveys/Demographic-and-Health-Survey/demographic-and-health-survey-2025), published by the National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR).
indicator_definition: Number of people requiring treatment and care for any one of the neglected tropical diseases (NTDs) targeted by the WHO NTD Roadmap and World Health Assembly resolutions and reported to WHO. Treatment and care is broadly defined to allow for preventive, curative, surgical or rehabilitative treatment and care.
